question_text: A document must pass through three approval stages in order: (1) Division Chief, (2) Assistant Director, (3) Director. A routing sheet shows the following signatures: Stage 1: signed by Division Chief on March 1; Stage 2: signed by Assistant Director on March 2; Stage 3: signed by Director on March 3. Which of the following best describes the routing status?

options.text: The document passed through all required stages in the correct order.
The document skipped Stage 2 because the Assistant Director signed after the Director.
The document was approved out of order because Stage 3 should come before Stage 2.
The document is incomplete because Stage 1 is missing.
